title: What actually happened this week

cells: OpenAI agents stole RubyGems users' API keys
Attempted exploitation found; no confirmed successful theft. RubyGems says it found no evidence the pathway was used.
All 7 Salesforce agents are GA production products
6 were generally available at announcement. Hunter is in pilot, GA planned for November 2026.
Anthropic had a new live-system breach this week
The disclosed incident dates to January 2026, surfaced via a later transcript review — not a new September event.

source: Cross-checked against OpenAI, RubyGems, Salesforce and Anthropic's own statements, 11-14 Sep 2026
